const RX = /durationUnit|planUnit|planDuration|interval|weeks?\b|months?\b|years?\b|days?\b|toLowerCase|unitLabel|t\(|\.replace\(/i;
return $input.all().map((i, n) => { const j = i.json; const text = Buffer.from(j.content || '', j.encoding || 'base64').toString('utf8'); const lines = text.split('\n'); const hits = []; lines.forEach((l, k) => { if (RX.test(l) && /durationUnit|unit|interval|week|month|year|day|duration/i.test(l)) hits.push((k + 1) + ': ' + l.trim().slice(0, 220)); }); return { json: { path: $('Files').all()[n].json.path, status: j.message || 'ok', hits: hits.slice(0, 60) } }; });
